title: Look before you act
concept: Run a block only when a condition about the world is True, with else for the other case

steps.say: Run it: move, then pick, 6 times.
Look first: `if gems_here():` picks only where there is a gem.
Gems in other places, same code. Run it.
Walk the row: a `for` loop that runs `move()` 8 times.
After `move()`, look: add `if gems_here():` inside the loop.
Indent `pick()` under the `if`, so it runs only on a gem.
Run it. The hidden rows put gems elsewhere.

guided.done: Every gem picked, wherever it was.

recap.say: `if condition:` runs its block only when the condition is True; `else:` runs when it is False.

fill_gaps: Compare your result with the Goal view: each cell ends with exactly one gem.
`put()` on a full cell makes two. `if not gems_here():` puts only on an empty cell.
flip_row: Look at the 'all full' world: every gem there should be picked up.
Two `if`s undo each other: after `pick()` the cell is empty, so the second `if` puts a gem back. Use `else:`.
detour: Look at the 'blocked right away' world, and compare with the Goal view.
Each pass: `if front_is_clear():` move, `else:` go around. Going around crosses 2 cells, so 7 passes cross all 8.

def turn_right():
    turn_left()
    turn_left()
    turn_left()


def go_around():
    turn_left()
    move()
    turn_right()
    __
    turn_right()
    move()
    turn_left()


for i in range(__):
    if front_is_clear():
        move()
    else:
        __
